proposedUse.title: Train a Moss & Moon lip-sync model from Harbor Heroes recordings
proposedUse.plainLanguageQuestion: Can I use voice recordings from a completed client show to train a lip-sync model for our own IP show?

source.notes: Twelve dialogue takes from two represented performers plus the verified MouthShape Research 2.0 pre-trained model used as the fine-tuning base.

unknowns: Authorised interpretation of mouth-shape model under Mateo's rider

operation.description: Train a model that predicts animation mouth shapes from dialogue audio.
operation.learnedCapability: Predict viseme and mouth-shape timing. The technical team must confirm whether performance characteristics can be reproduced or memorised.

purpose.description: Use the retained lip-sync capability to assist animation on Northstar-owned Moss & Moon.

requestedControls.control: Exclude all voice and likeness synthesis features

decision.answer: Hold the training. Business and Legal Affairs must resolve the client and performer permissions before the recordings enter the training environment.
decision.scopeSummary: Twelve Harbor Heroes dialogue takes from Ava Lin and Mateo Ruiz, used to train and retain a mouth-shape prediction model for Moss & Moon in MotionMap Lab's Australian private tenant.

gateResults.explanation: The exact recordings, both represented performers and the pre-trained model used for fine-tuning are identified and versioned.

basis.explanation: The exact recordings, both represented performers and the pre-trained model used for fine-tuning are identified and versioned.

gateResults.explanation: The base-model licence permits the declared fine-tuning and internal retained weights, but no verified client permission covers training from the recordings for a different production.
Ava requires purpose-specific agreement and Mateo's restriction requires an authorised technical and legal interpretation. Collective terms apply separately.
The secondary use of identifiable voice recordings requires a verified purpose-specific privacy basis and contributor process.
The learned capability, model retention duration and deletion plan require technical verification before approval can be assessed.
The destination is company-owned IP and differs from the client production that created the recordings.
The current Australian private tenant configuration is technically approved; source rights and final model retention remain separate unresolved gates.

changeTriggers: Fine-tune, redistribution or deployment scope change

facts.interpretation: The fictional terms permit private-tenant fine-tuning and internal use of resulting weights for production work, prohibit external redistribution, and require attribution in the internal model registry.
A purpose-specific training agreement and applicable compensation are required. No agreement for the proposed training is recorded.
Synthetic voice substitution is prohibited. Mouth-shape prediction is unaddressed and requires an authorised interpretation informed by technical evidence.
Individual AI permissions do not waive collective compensation and consultation minimums. Application to this proposal requires labour-relations review.
Synthetic performance and retained learned capability require separate collective coverage review.

facts.scope: Technical configuration approval includes 30-day service-output retention. Retention of the exported research model in the studio registry remains unresolved and is assessed separately.
